forecastNote: FiveThirtyEight daily archived snapshots; forecast_date is preserved as published and is not a precise live timestamp. Resolved advancement probabilities identify the games included in each snapshot; the interface derives its through-games status from those results. The latest snapshot precedes the championship.

ensembleReport.method: Expanding-window tests: each tested season uses only earlier seasons to fit. Equal weight per season. Individual comparisons use exactly the same games as their ensemble comparator. Available source sets vary by historical season; this tests the blending procedure, not today’s fitted coefficients.
